conclusion: Root cause: the disk is the macOS screen-recorder click highlight (`screencapture -k` / Show Mouse Clicks), not an app rendering or interaction defect. It appears only in recordings, is flat neutral #DEDEDE/#DDDDDD, and has no match in app DOM/CSS/geometry/materials. No app code change is required for the oval. The ground-plane panning fix and HUD wording clarification remain app changes.

rootCause.summary: macOS screen-recording click-highlight overlay, enabled by screencapture -k (Show Mouse Clicks)
rootCause.helpText: -k        show clicks in video recording mode
rootCause.removeBy: Uncheck Show Mouse Clicks in the macOS Screenshot toolbar Options, or run screencapture -v without -k.

superseded.reason: The white oval was reproduced in the running app during administrative-district hover and traced to an InstancedMesh recreation defect in src/components/ActorLayer.tsx.
superseded.currentRootCause: ActorLayer recreated the 106-instance marker mesh when district hover re-rendered its parent. Identity matrices briefly placed all white marker instances at the world origin.
superseded.currentFix: Stable module-level marker geometry/material and memoized args keep the InstancedMesh identity stable across hover renders.
